name: Linerixibat
sort_evidence: The FDA approved linerixibat as Lynavoy on 2026-03-17 and the CHMP gave a positive opinion on 2026-07-23, but GSK licensed worldwide rights to Alfasigma in a deal closed April 2026, so GSK keeps milestones and royalties only and the book holds no Lynavoy row (https://www.alfasigma.com/news-media/alfasigma-completes-agreement-with-gsk-for-linerixibat/).

trials.title: Linerixibat Long-term Safety, and Tolerability Study
